questions.solution_md:
Balandlik asos markaziga tushadi, shuning uchun asosga tashqi chizilgan aylana radiusi $\rho=\sqrt{l^2-h^2}=\sqrt{676-576}=10$.

Muntazam uchburchak tomoni $a=\rho\sqrt3=10\sqrt3$, yuzi $S=\frac{\sqrt3}{4}a^2=\frac{3\sqrt3}{4}\rho^2=\frac{300\sqrt3}{4}$.

$V=\frac13Sh=\frac13\cdot\frac{300\sqrt3}{4}\cdot24=600\sqrt{3}$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Asos uchburchagi tomonini $\rho$ ga teng deb olish ($a=\rho\sqrt3$ ekanini unutish) yoki hajm formulasida $\frac13$ ni tushirib qoldirish.

ru.solution_md:

Сторона правильного треугольника $a=\rho\sqrt3=10\sqrt3$, площадь $S=\frac{\sqrt3}{4}a^2=\frac{3\sqrt3}{4}\rho^2=\frac{300\sqrt3}{4}$.

$V=\frac13Sh=\frac13\cdot\frac{300\sqrt3}{4}\cdot24=600\sqrt{3}$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Принять сторону основания равной $\rho$ (забыв, что $a=\rho\sqrt3$) или опустить множитель $\frac13$ в формуле объёма.

en.solution_md:
The height meets the base at its center, so the circumradius of the base is $\rho=\sqrt{l^2-h^2}=\sqrt{676-576}=10$.

The side of the equilateral base is $a=\rho\sqrt3=10\sqrt3$ and its area is $S=\frac{\sqrt3}{4}a^2=\frac{3\sqrt3}{4}\rho^2=\frac{300\sqrt3}{4}$.

$V=\frac13Sh=\frac13\cdot\frac{300\sqrt3}{4}\cdot24=600\sqrt{3}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the side of the base to be $\rho$ (forgetting $a=\rho\sqrt3$) or dropping the factor $\frac13$ in the volume formula.

b) $V=\frac h3(a^2+ab+b^2)=\frac{4}{3}(400+80+16)=\frac{1984}{3}$.

The slant height $m$ of a lateral face: the distance from the center of the base to a side of the base is $\frac{a}{2}=7$, so $m=\sqrt{24^2+7^2}=25$.

The lateral surface consists of four equal triangles: $S=4\cdot\frac12 am=2am=2\cdot14\cdot25=700$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the pyramid height instead of the slant height, or adding the base area (that gives the total surface).

kaa.solution_md:
a) Tiykar diagonalınıń yarımı $\frac{a\sqrt2}{2}$, jan qabırǵa hám biyiklik menen tuwrı múyeshli úshmúyeshlik payda etedi: $h^2=l^2-\frac{a^2}{2}=121-72=49$, $h=7$.

b) $V=\frac13a^2h=\frac13\cdot144\cdot7=336$.

en.solution_md:
a) Half of the base diagonal $\frac{a\sqrt2}{2}$, the lateral edge and the height form a right triangle: $h^2=l^2-\frac{a^2}{2}=121-72=49$, $h=7$.

en.mistake_note_md: Using $\frac a2$ instead of half the base diagonal: that works for the slant height, not for the lateral edge.

questions.solution_md:
Yon yoqning balandligi (apofema) $m$: asos markazidan yon yoq asosigacha masofa $\frac{a}{2}=12$, shuning uchun $m=\sqrt{h^2+12^2}=\sqrt{16^2+12^2}=20$.

Yon sirt to'rtta teng uchburchakdan iborat: $S=4\cdot\frac12 am=2am=2\cdot24\cdot20=960$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Apofema o'rniga piramida balandligini ishlatish yoki asos yuzini ham qo'shib yuborish (bu to'liq sirt bo'lib qoladi).

ru.solution_md:

Боковая поверхность состоит из четырёх равных треугольников: $S=4\cdot\frac12 am=2am=2\cdot24\cdot20=960$.

en.solution_md:
The slant height $m$ of a lateral face: the distance from the center of the base to a side of the base is $\frac{a}{2}=12$, so $m=\sqrt{16^2+12^2}=20$.

The lateral surface consists of four equal triangles: $S=4\cdot\frac12 am=2am=2\cdot24\cdot20=960$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the pyramid height instead of the slant height, or adding the base area (that gives the total surface).

The slant height $m$ of a lateral face: the distance from the center of the base to a side of the base is $\frac{a}{2}=12$, so $m=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13$.

The lateral surface consists of four equal triangles: $S=4\cdot\frac12 am=2am=2\cdot24\cdot13=624$.

questions.solution_md:
Balandlik asos markaziga tushadi, shuning uchun asosga tashqi chizilgan aylana radiusi $\rho=\sqrt{l^2-h^2}=\sqrt{169-144}=5$.

Muntazam uchburchak tomoni $a=\rho\sqrt3=5\sqrt3$, yuzi $S=\frac{\sqrt3}{4}a^2=\frac{3\sqrt3}{4}\rho^2=\frac{75\sqrt3}{4}$.

$V=\frac13Sh=\frac13\cdot\frac{75\sqrt3}{4}\cdot12=75\sqrt{3}$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Asos uchburchagi tomonini $\rho$ ga teng deb olish ($a=\rho\sqrt3$ ekanini unutish) yoki hajm formulasida $\frac13$ ni tushirib qoldirish.

а) Диагонали оснований $a\sqrt2$ и $b\sqrt2$; разность их половин $\frac{(a-b)\sqrt2}{2}$ — проекция бокового ребра. $h^2=l^2-\frac{(a-b)^2}{2}=36-32=4$, $h=2$.

б) $V=\frac h3(a^2+ab+b^2)=\frac{2}{3}(144+48+16)=\frac{416}{3}$.

en.mistake_note_md: Taking the projection of the lateral edge to be $\frac{a-b}{2}$ (it is the difference of the half-diagonals), or forgetting the term $ab$ in the volume formula.

en.solution_md:
The slant height $m$ of a lateral face: the distance from the center of the base to a side of the base is $\frac{a}{2}=24$, so $m=\sqrt{10^2+24^2}=26$.

The lateral surface consists of four equal triangles: $S=4\cdot\frac12 am=2am=2\cdot48\cdot26=2496$.

en.solution_md:
The height meets the base at its center, so the circumradius of the base is $\rho=\sqrt{l^2-h^2}=\sqrt{100-36}=8$.

The side of the equilateral base is $a=\rho\sqrt3=8\sqrt3$ and its area is $S=\frac{\sqrt3}{4}a^2=\frac{3\sqrt3}{4}\rho^2=\frac{192\sqrt3}{4}$.

$V=\frac13Sh=\frac13\cdot\frac{192\sqrt3}{4}\cdot6=96\sqrt{3}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the side of the base to be $\rho$ (forgetting $a=\rho\sqrt3$) or dropping the factor $\frac13$ in the volume formula.

questions.solution_md:
a) Asoslar diagonallari $a\sqrt2$ va $b\sqrt2$; ularning yarmlari ayirmasi $\frac{(a-b)\sqrt2}{2}$ yon qirra proyeksiyasidir. $h^2=l^2-\frac{(a-b)^2}{2}=361-72=289$, $h=17$.

b) $V=\frac h3(a^2+ab+b^2)=\frac{17}{3}(289+85+25)=2261$.

en.mistake_note_md: Taking the projection of the lateral edge to be $\frac{a-b}{2}$ (it is the difference of the half-diagonals), or forgetting the term $ab$ in the volume formula.

The slant height $m$ of a lateral face: the distance from the center of the base to a side of the base is $\frac{a}{2}=20$, so $m=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25$.

The lateral surface consists of four equal triangles: $S=4\cdot\frac12 am=2am=2\cdot40\cdot25=2000$.

b) $V=\frac h3(a^2+ab+b^2)=\frac{4}{3}(441+105+25)=\frac{2284}{3}$.

a) The base diagonals are $a\sqrt2$ and $b\sqrt2$; the difference of their halves $\frac{(a-b)\sqrt2}{2}$ is the projection of the lateral edge. $h^2=l^2-\frac{(a-b)^2}{2}=144-128=16$, $h=4$.

b) $V=\frac h3(a^2+ab+b^2)=\frac{4}{3}(441+105+25)=\frac{2284}{3}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the projection of the lateral edge to be $\frac{a-b}{2}$ (it is the difference of the half-diagonals), or forgetting the term $ab$ in the volume formula.

Высота боковой грани (апофема) $m$: расстояние от центра основания до стороны основания равно $\frac{a}{2}=24$, поэтому $m=\sqrt{7^2+24^2}=25$.

Боковая поверхность состоит из четырёх равных треугольников: $S=4\cdot\frac12 am=2am=2\cdot48\cdot25=2400$.
ru.mistake_note_md: Использовать вместо апофемы высоту пирамиды или добавить площадь основания (получится полная поверхность).

en.solution_md:
The slant height $m$ of a lateral face: the distance from the center of the base to a side of the base is $\frac{a}{2}=24$, so $m=\sqrt{7^2+24^2}=25$.

The lateral surface consists of four equal triangles: $S=4\cdot\frac12 am=2am=2\cdot48\cdot25=2400$.
en.mistake_note_md: Using the pyramid height instead of the slant height, or adding the base area (that gives the total surface).
